explanation: The right query adds up the clicks and the impressions over the 7 calendar days with a RANGE frame, divides once, and keeps July only after the window has read late June. Averaging the daily rates weights a quiet day like a busy one. A ROWS frame takes the last 7 rows, which reach back further when a day had no spend. Filtering July before the window leaves 1 to 6 July with short windows.
